note: Independent review of packages/sensors on the author's Mac (macOS 12, Intel, CPU throttled). Local checks only: no Meta Model API key exists on this machine, so no live model call was made or claimed.

tests.runtime: 56 passed (run outside the shell sandbox; inside it, listener-binding tests fail with PermissionError on bind, unrelated to the code)

gates: env_check: only MODEL_API_KEY presence fails (len=0), by design of the owner step
release_check ok after skipping .venv in the SPDX scan
bugs_fixed: devserver SSE starved after the 500-event buffer trimmed: client offset was a list index into a trimmed list; now sequence-based, guarded by the Condition readers wait on
narration idle suggestion carried neither won-back nor adoption-cost numbers, bypassing the both-numbers ranking rule; suppressed as uncalibrated
ingest deleted a whole batch on a partial gateway accept, losing the unaccepted remainder; now drops only accepted events
importer resolved the open episode through the category resolver on the tick path, where its injected ask is a model call; now local rules only on tick, resolution at episode close
release_check walked .venv and failed on any machine with a virtualenv; .venv added to the skip set
micro_enhancements: ingest queue list.pop(0) replaced with collections.deque (O(1) amortised prune)
one consent state snapshot per tick instead of one file stat per adapter
redact regex fast path plus a bounded SHA-256-keyed cache of redacted titles (raw titles never retained); cached title 3.2us vs 40.3us uncached for a secret-shaped title
metrics skips the per-window sort for chronological episodes; episode history and tick timings bounded

adapters: one osascript spawn per macOS window poll, two spawns per Linux window poll, Linux input classification outside the lock with no inline sleep in poll, _run raises on non-zero exit so probes cannot report a broken tool as available
open_items: owner step unchanged: place MODEL_API_KEY in ~/.config/humanflow/runtime.env (mode 600) or paste it on the gateway settings page, then make gateway

settings_surface.note: Built after the review, on the production gateway (loopback-guarded like every gateway route). The settings page is the single acceptance surface: it states that nothing is sensed until a source is turned on, and every choice writes the same consent file the sensors re-read each tick.
endpoints: POST /v1/settings/key (twin of the dev-server endpoint and scripts/set_key.py; 0600, fingerprint only)
GET /v1/settings/consent (per-source state plus the titles preference)
POST /v1/settings/consent (grant with TTL, revoke one or all, titles on/off; emits consent.changed on the bus)
settings_surface.tests: runtime suite grew from 56 to 62 tests, including an HTTP round-trip of the page, key save and consent grant; sensors suite grew from 22 to 23 with the live titles-preference test
